item.title: [SAGE-Kit M1 real-API test] feedback sync smoke 20261023T180208Z
item.bodyPreview: Automated M1 real-API verification issue created by teammate m1-feedback for SAGE-Kit. Purpose: prove that `sage-kit feedback sync --source github --repo JoeKeepGo/SAGE-Kit` fetches a real GitHub issue (not a fixture) and stores it in `.sage-kit/feedback/items.jsonl`. The issue body is handled as untrusted data and is never executed. This issue is closed by the same verification run. Evidence: reports/m1/github-real.md. No action needed.
item.author: JoeKeepGo
